stamp: {"keys":[{"id":"k","problem":"The current-account guide's interest example and chart are one bank's (Leumi) terms and one person's case, shown as if general, though most people's idle money earns nothing and slowly loses value.","where":"the interest lines and the expanded chart","kind":"general"}],"liked":[]}

raised: Can't tell which product to pick: the page names alternatives but never compares what each would give
The '123 מקמן / חושב / הזנה' row is confusing, and 'מקמן' is unknown
The basic and extended packages are described with no prices
The calculator assumes a 5% return for an account that often pays nothing; it should start at 0%, showing money shrinking
Codes like BANK-20/23/15, TXI OQ11 and BANK OQ9 mean nothing
The costs section doesn't say what fees are in shekels (just 'the bank's price list'), and the rules column is empty
The red box is worrying and unclear: does the low-income tax exemption apply?
The risks are frightening: no deposit insurance, government help is discretionary, and the 250k protection is only a proposal
The site doesn't calculate age exemptions, which is exactly the reader's situation
Deposits show 62,681, not 70,000, with no label saying it's in today's money
The pink tax line and orange fees line are too thin to see
The age field doesn't say what changes at those ages
'הטבה בנקאית' is unclear
Wanted the actual interest rates banks pay on current accounts
Wanted guidance on how much to keep in the account and how much to move
Unsure whether a money-market fund is safe without deposit insurance
Would drop the terms table
Would drop 'מה האתר לקח בחשבון' (except the age line)
Would drop 'מי מציע ומי מפקח'
Would drop the future-shekels toggle and the inflation/age fields

problems.why: The reader objects that the chart shows money earning 5% as if that were normal, when the page itself says many current accounts pay nothing, so idle money really shrinks; that is the heart of the person's complaint, even though Leumi isn't named.
